posts.content: Just finished reading 'The Go Programming Language' and it's fantastic! Really helped me understand interfaces and goroutines better. Highly recommend it to anyone learning Go.
Went hiking in the mountains today. The view was absolutely breathtaking! Nothing beats disconnecting from the digital world for a bit.
Working on a new project using Go channels for the first time. The concurrency model is so elegant compared to traditional threading models.
Private post just for my close followers. Thanks for sticking around!
Morning coffee and code. The best way to start the day! ☕
Just finished setting up my home server. Running a few hobby projects and learning Kubernetes. Private profile means I can share freely here.
Chess rating just hit 1800! All those late-night practice sessions are finally paying off.
Organizing a community cleanup event next weekend. Who's in? Let's make our neighborhood cleaner together!
Just created the Golang Enthusiasts group! If you're interested in Go programming, come join us!
Book club recommendation for this month: 'Designing Data-Intensive Applications'. It's a game changer for understanding distributed systems.
New guitar arrived today! A Fender Stratocaster in sunburst finish. Time to learn some new riffs! 🎸
Refactored a legacy codebase from 10k lines to 3k lines this week. The feeling when you delete more code than you add is unmatched.
Golden hour at the beach today. Captured some amazing shots with the new lens.
Started learning Go this week and I'm loving it! The simplicity is refreshing after years of Java.
Has anyone tried the new structured logging package in Go 1.21? I'm thinking of migrating from logrus.
Just published a new package for middleware chaining in Go. Check it out and let me know what you think!
Shot this beautiful landscape at sunrise. Edited in Lightroom. What do you think?
Anyone else excited about Go 1.24? The new iterators and unique package look incredible. Can't wait to refactor some old code.
Just adopted a rescue cat! Meet Whiskers 🐱 He's already claimed my keyboard as his sleeping spot. Say goodbye to productivity!
New blog post just went live: 'Setting up a home Kubernetes cluster on a budget'. Links to a full guide covering k3s, MetalLB, and longhorn storage.
Thinking about switching careers after 10 years in finance. The tech world seems exciting and I've been learning a ton. Anyone else made a similar jump?
Just beat my personal record on LeetCode! 3 hard problems in under 2 hours. All that practice on data structures is paying off.
Volunteer opportunity at the local animal shelter this Saturday. We need 10 more people for the adoption event. Who's in?
Anyone planning to attend GopherCon this year? Would be great to organize a group trip from our local Go meetup!
Learning Rust on the side and I have to say — the borrow checker is painful at first but the safety guarantees are incredible. Go is still my favorite though!
New Canon RF 70-200mm f/2.8 lens arrived today! The bokeh on this thing is unreal. Time to shoot some portraits this weekend.
My summer photo collection is coming along nicely. Over 500 shots from three different states so far. Thinking of putting together a print portfolio.
This was an old post that I've since deleted. The home server project is going great though!
